label: The Last Caravan
summary: You signed on to guard the last caravan of the season. Nobody will say what is in the sealed chest, or why it is humming.
title: The Last Caravan
description: Twelve wagons, nine guards, one sealed chest that hums at night. The caravan master pays double, and she will not say why.

chapterOutlines.title: The Gate at Dawn
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the caravan and its master, and notice who else is watching it leave.

chapterOutlines.title: The Ashen Marches
chapterOutlines.outline: Ambush, weather and a choice about who to trust.

chapterOutlines.title: What the Chest Holds
chapterOutlines.outline: The chest opens, by choice or by force.

scene.location: The eastern gate of Calder's Rest, at dawn
scene.summary: Wagons creak into line. The sealed chest rides in the third wagon under a tarp, and the air around it smells faintly of lightning.

openThreads: What is in the sealed chest?
Who paid the caravan master double?

npcs.name: Oriel Vance
npcs.description: Twenty years on the Ember Road and every one of them shows. Pays well, trusts no one, laughs at the worst moments.
goals: Deliver the chest without opening it
abilities: Reads people and weather equally well
